builds.name: Reference: Ranked jungle core
builds.goal: Reference for Rammus: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ jungle players use most (2,480 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 60.2% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A resistance-scaling disruptor who reaches a target with Powerball and induces attacks through taunt. The current passive converts both armor and MR to AD, while W returns magic damage. The current jungle provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Thornmail → Sunfire Aegis → Jak'Sho, The Protean. Aftershock keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Randuin's Omen, Unending Despair.
builds.summary: The proven jungle baseline: Thornmail → Sunfire Aegis → Jak'Sho, The Protean, with Aftershock.
testPlan: Play it in jungle as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Thornmail → Sunfire Aegis → Jak'Sho, The Protean) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 60.2% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Thornmail → Sunfire Aegis → Jak'Sho, The Protean.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

Rammus stops after colliding with an enemy, dealing [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (1) × AP] magic damage, Knocking Back, and Slowing nearby enemies by [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80]% for [1] second.

builds.name: Resistance AD shell boxer
builds.summary: Test resistance ad shell boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test resistance ad shell boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Spiked Shell currently grants AD equal to 15% armor plus 15% MR, rather than the historical magic on-hit passive; Defensive Ball Curl raises both resistances for seven seconds. Jak'Sho and dual resistances therefore support own physical attacks, while Blade and Terminus add mixed packets.
testPlan: Required state: W active with a target forced to attack by E.
Record AD before W, during W and after Jak'Sho then measure three attacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Without attack speed from old E assumptions, target access limits the damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The old armor-to-magic-attack premise is contradicted by this passive record.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Jak'Sho, The Protean, Blade of The Ruined King, Terminus, Randuin's Omen, Force of Nature, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.hypothesis: A resistance-scaling disruptor who reaches a target with Powerball and induces attacks through taunt. The current passive converts both armor and MR to AD, while W returns magic damage. Current passive converts both armor and MR into AD; measure W defenses, reflected damage and real attacks. Do not reuse an old armor-only magic-on-hit formula. Movement and matchup resistances test reaching a useful control angle and resetting afterward.
builds.summary: Movement and matchup resistances test reaching a useful control angle and resetting afterward.
testPlan: Kit question for Rammus: Current passive converts both armor and MR into AD; measure W defenses, reflected damage and real attacks. Do not reuse an old armor-only magic-on-hit formula.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense and boots; movement slots only if they improve contact) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Movement and matchup resistances test reaching a useful control angle and resetting afterward. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Limited direct damage; Warmog thresholds and out-of-combat timing must be verified.

The route fails Rammus's stated kit question: Current passive converts both armor and MR into AD; measure W defenses, reflected damage and real attacks. Do not reuse an old armor-only magic-on-hit formula.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Limited direct damage; Warmog thresholds and out-of-combat timing must be verified.
Full cost 15,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Matchup defense and boots; movement slots only if they improve contact. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Warmog's Armor, Jak'Sho, The Protean, Unending Despair are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

Compare plain R versus Q-assisted centered R on a champion.
